description.p: Auryn is a desktop front-end for streamrip, the open-source command-line audio downloader. It turns streamrip's terminal workflow into a single window: paste a link, pick a quality, and watch progress, metadata, cover art and lyrics appear as your library grows.
Finished downloads can be sorted into a tidy Album Artist / Album / Quality tree, so Jellyfin, Plex, Symfonium and Plexamp index them immediately.

This Flatpak bundles streamrip and all of its Python dependencies, so there is nothing to install by hand. You supply your own service credentials; they are written only to streamrip's own configuration file inside the sandbox, and are never displayed or logged.

Auryn does not host, distribute or provide access to any content. It is a graphical wrapper around a tool you configure yourself, and you are responsible for using it within the terms of the services you access.
